sentences.en: She was kind enough to accommodate me with some money.
sentences.zh: 她很慷慨地借给了我一些钱。

sentences.en: Could I really afford to accommodate such a raucous comrade?
sentences.zh: 我真的能负担得起容纳这样一个吵闹的室友吗？

sentences.en: The boy soon accommodated himself to his new class.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩很快就适应了他的新班级。
